thread:
mira: Quick sync — we need to finalize the instrumentation gating for Console GA. Customer asks landed from three accounts: richer cost breakdown, per-route trace hooks, and error-class summaries. I sketched a proposal below.

devon: +1. can you paste the proposal? trying to map to the sprint.

mira: TL;DR: propose 3 phased launch lanes: 1) Dashboards + cost rollups (low risk), 2) Lightweight trace hook landing (sampling + trace links), 3) Error-class analytics (needs eval infra). Gate rules: lane 1 must hit perf and cost budgets; lane 2 gated by tracing P95 < 200ms for on-path operations; lane 3 gated by false-positive rate < 8% on error grouping.

alex: Thanks — couple clarifying q's: what counts as "trace hook" here? is it just an SDK flag to emit span links, or full tracing storage?

mira: Good question. We mean the minimal hook: a route-level trace header that attaches a short trace id and link to the trace viewer. No storage changes for GA. Storage + long-term retention would be a post-GA opt-in.

lisa: From SE feedback: customers want per-customer cost breakdown by model-version + route. that's non-negotiable for two enterprise deals. How tight are the timelines?

mira: Two-week runway for lane 1 MVP (dashboard tiles + model-version cost column). Lane 2 earliest in 4 weeks if eng can reuse existing trace headers. Lane 3 is 6–8 weeks depending on eval infra.

sam: For lane 1 acceptance: can we define measurable criteria? otherwise sales will say "not delivered." Suggest: (a) dashboard has tile for model-version cost; (b) sample query for top-10 routes; (c) query latency <= 500ms for dashboard loads under 10k rows.

trent: On lane 2 gating: sampling has to be configurable per-customer. We should avoid enabling high-volume tracing by default. Proposal: default sample rate 0.1% with per-org override.

mira: Agree. Add gating: must support per-org overrides and UI control. If that isn't ready, we can't enable lane 2 for Dedicated customers.

sam: Also callout: billing accuracy. Cost breakdown requires token-accurate attribution to model variant. Need to verify current ingestion path preserves token counts for split routes. Devon, can infra confirm?

devon: I ran a quick check. Current usage pipeline preserves tokens, but we aggregate hourly which hides route-level spikes. We can emit route-tagged entries; cost calc runs in daily job. For lane 1 MVP we can do near-real-time top-up but not sub-minute.

alex: That seems fine for GA if we set expectation. Add to acceptance that granularity is hourly and call it out in UI copy.

lisa: On error analytics (lane 3): customers want grouping by root-cause (model vs prompt vs infra). We don't have reliable signals to separate model-vs-prompt. That needs lightweight eval harness + labeled prompt sets.

mira: Exactly. For lane 3 propose: (1) error ingestion pipeline with basic grouping heuristics, (2) an "assign root cause" manual override in the UI, (3) a telemetry job that compares grouped errors to labeled set for FP rate. Gate is FP < 8% on labeled set.

deploy-bot: deploy: staging/console-instrumentation-feature-branch started at commit abc123.

trent: One more operational ask: add rate-limits on dashboard queries to avoid cost spikes. Default throttling to 5 rps per user for heavy analytics endpoints.

sam: Noted. I'll file a perf ticket for dashboard query throttles + caching layer.

mira: Next steps: 1) devon to confirm token attribution latency and add a ticket for per-route tagging (ETA 3 days), 2) eng to scope per-org sampling UI + override (ETA 2 sprints), 3) product to draft customer-facing GA notes that call out hourly cost granularity and trace sampling defaults (I'll draft by EOD). Anyone blocking?

devon: Working on the ticket now. If we hit unexpected storage work, call it out asap.

alex: I can help with the UI copy for the sampling controls.

lisa: I'll loop in the two enterprise AE teams so they can set expectations.

mira: Great — will update the roadmap doc after we get devon ETA. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
